journey.name: Settings import backup
journey.description: Import end-to-end (issue #28): open the app, go to Settings, replace all data from a JSON backup through the system file picker, and verify the result dialog lists the per-table imported counts and the Calendar shows the imported snakes.

actions.action: Launch Snake Tracker; verify the Calendar tab is shown with its title.
Tap the Settings tab in the bottom navigation bar; verify the Settings screen opens with an "Import backup" row.
Tap the "Import backup" row; verify the system open-document (Storage Access Framework) picker opens filtered to JSON files.
Select a Snake Tracker backup file; verify a confirmation dialog appears warning that importing replaces all current data.
Tap "Import" to confirm; verify a "Backup imported" dialog appears listing the imported counts per table (snakes, feedings, sheds, weights, food stock items).
Tap OK in the dialog; verify the dialog closes and the Settings screen is visible again.
Tap the Calendar tab; verify the agenda shows the snakes that came from the imported backup.
